confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Tirana and Albanian price levels for a July peak-season window. No live booking pages or menus were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, where July demand and new hotel supply make the 3-star figure the least certain. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price, since direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation (0.6955 on 2026-10-15) comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page or the F11 table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Western Balkan capitals with similar tourism profiles and price levels (for example Skopje, Podgorica and Sarajevo), adjusted for Tirana's own summer hotel and bar pricing.
